retrievalProfile.description: Use this skill for high-contrast, 1980s-inspired layouts featuring cel-shaded character art against vibrant pink backgrounds with diagonal geometric accents.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, 1980s-inspired composition featuring a cel-shaded female character in a blue dress positioned on the right, balanced by a stack of diverse typographic styles on the left, all set against a hot pink background with diagonal cyan and white stripes.
coreVisualRelationships: Character on right balances heavy typographic block on left
Diagonal background stripes create dynamic movement toward the character
High-contrast color palette of pink, cyan, and black defines the retro mood
Black header bar anchors the top of the composition
coreInvariants: Hot pink background with diagonal geometric stripes
Cel-shaded character illustration with thick black outlines
Multi-layered typographic hierarchy with distinct font styles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Character occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, scaled from waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, blocky title text in the upper left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left title, move down through the script text to the bottom logo, then sweep right to the character's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated around the character's head and between the text blocks to prevent clutter.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high value across all primary elements for a 'neon' effect.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mixed: Heavy Sans-Serif, Casual Script, and Stylized Display
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses thick black outlines with white fills and tight tracking
Secondary script uses fluid, connected strokes with a hand-drawn feel
Bottom logo uses heavy, italicized block letters with a lightning bolt motif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'i' in script often replaced with heart or dot
Letters in the main title are interlocking or touching
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast heavy, rigid block lettering with soft, organic script for a dynamic 'street' vs 'glamour' feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, interlocking block style of the main title.
Captures the 80s casual script aesthetic for secondary text.
Suitable for the bold, condensed header text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vibrant hot pink background with diagonal cyan and white stripes. On the right side, place a cel-shaded illustration of a woman with 80s hair and a blue dress. Include a solid black bar at the very top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a stacked blocky title in the top left with thick black outlines. Below it, add a white script font tilted slightly. At the bottom left, place a stylized logo with a yellow lightning bolt.

verificationChecks: Is the character cel-shaded with thick outlines?
Is the text stacked and outlined?
Is there a black bar at the top?

mustRedesign: Do not use trademarked character names
Ensure character features are generic and not based on specific celebrities
postGenerationChecks: Check for thick black outlines on all subjects
Verify the diagonal stripes are sharp and consistent
Ensure the text hierarchy is clear and legible
Confirm the color palette is limited to the specified neon tones
recipe.reuseFormula: 80s Pop Layout = (Cel-Shaded Character + Diagonal Stripes) * (Stacked Block Typography + Script Accents) / Neon Pink Palette
